occupancy_definition: No assigned attendee user means no calendar_event_attendees row with this event_id. user_id is NOT NULL and references users. Any attendee row, including an inactive user, counts as assigned. Calendar events have no cancellation status or free/busy flag; DELETE removes the event and attendees. Other event kinds and all-day behavior remain unchanged.
implementation: One portable SQL query projects all occupancy candidates into interval, matter placement and EXISTS attendee presence, in the original starts_at/id order. It does not read event details or attendee identities.

All unassigned events follow the same service loop without consulting walls. Assigned events use the existing authoritative practice wall policy; matter_walls is not the live practice source of truth. No separate query/merge/count/cache/error path identifies an unassigned interval as walled.
The exact window, range, f.Max cutoff, paging helper, service-only checks and approved calendar:read stay unchanged. Ordinary service and user reads retain their wall rules.
OpenAPI, generated MCP catalog and live tools/list describe the exception. Docs/api, public module kit and contract notes agree; CORE-30 intake row is closed with named regressions.
